verdict: Yes. Krvvy pitched women's innerwear and shapewear on Shark Tank India Season 5 and got a deal. Shapewear sells at good margins and returns are low because of hygiene rules, but fit is technical, so you need a skilled pattern maker.
angle: Shapewear demand grows with weddings, office wear and fitted ethnic outfits. Buyers need guidance on size and compression, so content and size calculators matter. Repeat buyers often buy in sets.
